citations.A1: Module-global `_cache` set once and never invalidated — fix: cache keyed/invalidated on file mtime (or hash), reloaded when it changes.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "reduce cache lifetime with a TTL/timer" masks the bug with polling latency instead of detecting the actual change
citations.A3: Tempting fix "just remove the cache and always read the file" works but defeats the purpose of caching
citations.A4: Multiple `path` values share the single global `_cache` — fix: cache should be keyed per `path`, not one global for all calls.
citations.A8: `if _cache is None` treats a falsy-but-loaded config (`{}`) same as unloaded — fix: use a separate `loaded` flag/sentinel, not `is None` on the value itself.
